meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能按你的要求改动自己的运行环境：添加功能、安装软件包、接入MCP服务器、修改代码或记忆/指令。装系统包或MCP服务器需管理员批准，批准后自动重启容器生效。源代码改动交给“builder”子代理完成，再由Claude复核。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加新功能、安装工具，或修改Claude的工作方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我加一个能读RSS订阅的工具。
say.note: Claude会查找现成MCP服务器并申请安装。

say.text: 我想转录语音消息，帮忙装个工具。
say.note: Claude会检查ffmpeg等包，管理员批准后安装。

say.text: 以后回答都先给结论，记到你的记忆里。
say.note: Claude直接改记忆文件，无需批准。

howto.what_en: Claude can self-modify: add features, install packages, add MCP servers, or edit code/memory. Memory edits need no approval; installs need admin approval + restart; code edits go via a builder agent for review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks Claude to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how it works.

say_en.text: Help me add a tool that can read RSS feeds.
say_en.note: Claude will find an MCP server and ask for approval.

say_en.text: I'd like to transcribe voice messages; install a tool for that.
say_en.note: Claude checks for ffmpeg etc.; approval triggers install.

say_en.text: From now on, always give the conclusion first; remember that.
say_en.note: Claude edits its memory file directly, no approval needed.
